observations.posthog_connection: These options configure the Kafka consumer behavior for PostHog's ingestion workers. kafka_consumer_group_instance_id enables static group membership, allowing pod identity stability during restarts without triggering consumer group rebalances, which could disrupt ingestion. kafka_consumer_partition_strategy controls the partition assignment protocol, with updated comments warning,
